# Hello World

Hello World is an open-source web playground by Nikita Zhurakov. It is built with plain HTML, CSS, and a little JavaScript.

## Important pages

- Home: https://zhurakov.com/
- Projects: https://zhurakov.com/posts/projects.html
- Link Library: https://zhurakov.com/posts/links.html
- Games: https://zhurakov.com/posts/games.html
- Privacy: https://zhurakov.com/privacy.html

## Link Library

The Link Library is a collection of websites, services, and projects worth sharing. Inclusion does not imply that Nikita uses, endorses, or is affiliated with a listed project.
